newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Sampath up on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Sampath up on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sampath Bank Ltd rose 3.5 percent or three rupees to 88.50 in early Monday trade, underpinned by market expectations of good second half, brokers said.
"The bank, which saw net profits grow by 21.2 percent to 150.22 million in the six months to June, is expected to see even better results in the next six months," said a local broker.
Analysts have forecast Sampath Banks net profits for the year to December to rise by about 20 percent to between 325 million and 350 million rupees against 282 million in 1996.
The blue chip bank is one of four private commercial banks trading in Colombo. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
